component.name: hwcloud-functiongraph
component.title: Huawei FunctionGraph
component.description: Invoke serverless functions in Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph.
component.label: cloud,serverless

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

producerIn.description: The event of the function, which FunctionGraph takes as a JSON object: a Map, or a JSON object as text, bytes, a stream or a file. A JSON array or another JSON value fails: wrap it in a JSON object. A POJO fails unless its text is JSON: marshal it to JSON first. No body fails

producerOut.description: The result of the function as text. When the result is a JSON object with a top-level body field, such as the result of a function behind an API Gateway trigger, the body field: a string as it is, an object or an array as JSON, and no body when the field is null. Otherwise the whole result as it is. No body when the function gives no result. With the CamelHwCloudFgXCffLogType exchange property set, the log of the call is in the CamelHwCloudFgXCffLogs exchange property

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. Only invokeFunction is supported. The CamelHwCloudFgOperation exchange property replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint URL of FunctionGraph, for example https://functiongraph.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com. When set, the client uses it instead of the endpoint of the region option. The region option is still needed for the URN of the function.

functionName.description: The name of the function to invoke. The producer always invokes the latest version of the function. The CamelHwCloudFgFunction exchange property replaces this option, and one of them must be set.

functionPackage.description: The package of the function, which is part of the URN of the function. The CamelHwCloudFgPackage exchange property replaces this option.

projectId.description: The ID of the Huawei Cloud project of the function. The producer uses it in the URN of the function and in the credentials of the requests.

region.description: The region ID of FunctionGraph, for example cn-north-4. The producer uses it in the URN of the function, and to build the client when the endpoint option is not set.

serviceKeys.description: The AK/SK pair as an org.apache.camel.component.huaweicloud.common.models.ServiceKeys. When set, its accessKey and secretKey replace the accessKey and secretKey options.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name or IP address of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when both this option and the proxyPort option are set.

proxyPassword.label: proxy
proxyPassword.description: The password to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyUser option is set.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when both this option and the proxyHost option are set.

proxyUser.label: proxy
proxyUser.description: The user name to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID (AK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. It is not used when the serviceKeys option is set.

ignoreSslVerification.label: security
ignoreSslVerification.description: Whether to skip the verification of the TLS certificate of the server. This makes the connection insecure: use it only for testing.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key (SK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. It is not used when the serviceKeys option is set.
